title: Astronaut UFO code names per Edgar Mitchell
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Astronaut UFO code names per Edgar Mitchell, about 1960s-1970s at NASA, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: fascinating. This guy in Japan said that they had uh he spoke he was close with Edgar Mitchell as well and he said that they had um code names according to Edgar Mitchell.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says a man in Japan named Takano Jouen, who was close to the Apollo astronaut Edgar Mitchell, told him something Mitchell had said. According to Jouen, Mitchell said astronauts in the 1960s and 70s used code names to talk about UFOs. If true, it would mean astronauts saw such things often enough to need a secret way to talk about them.
